venues.name: Long.xyz
venues.thesis: Long.xyz lists tokenized equities with on-chain inventory backing and real secondary volume.

rationale.asset: Inventory of tokenized equities reconciles against custodian statements each settlement cycle.
rationale.traction: Leads the register on cumulative and daily volume with sustained weekly turnover.
rationale.transparency: Factory contract verified and docs public, but lock schedules stay partly off-chain.
rationale.compliance: EU prospectus route via licensed custodian, yet redemption rights remain limited.
rationale.durability: Live across multiple market shocks with steady operator funding and deep pools.

facts: of all tokenized stock TVL on the chain

venues.name: Pons
venues.thesis: Pons moves the highest daily flow in the register against thinner asset backing.

rationale.asset: Issuance references custodied equities but coverage reports lag new listings by weeks.
rationale.traction: Top daily volume venue with the densest pool activity in the observation window.
rationale.transparency: Verified contracts, public inventory snapshots, and a named operating entity.
rationale.compliance: Standard token disclaimers only, with no prospectus or license cited.
rationale.durability: Two years live with consistent uptime and steadily growing liquidity.

facts: cumulative volume in USD across tracked pools

venues.name: StonkFun
venues.thesis: StonkFun is a Solana memecoin launcher whose only real asset exposure is an index pairing.

rationale.asset: Index pairing tracks listed equities without custody or redemption for holders.
rationale.traction: Strong launch cadence and fee flow, though volumes swing hard with sentiment.
rationale.transparency: Program code public and pools visible, while index method stays lightly documented.
rationale.compliance: Launcher disclaimers only, with no licensing statement for the tracked assets.
rationale.durability: Survived one full hype cycle with the operator still shipping weekly.

facts: daily fees in USD at the cut date

venues.name: Pools.trade
venues.thesis: Pools.trade runs audited index vaults with modest flow but strong disclosure.

rationale.asset: Vaults hold index positions rather than custodied securities, capping asset quality.
rationale.traction: Mid-tier volume with stable fee revenue from long-lived pools.
rationale.transparency: Verified contracts, published audits, and open vault accounting.
rationale.compliance: Clear risk disclosure and terms, though no securities license is claimed.
rationale.durability: Oldest venue in the set with uninterrupted operation and deep reserves.

facts: vault TVL in USD at the cut date

venues.name: Flap
venues.thesis: Flap pairs solid equity backing with thin trading activity and early-stage disclosure.

rationale.asset: Tokenized equities map to custodied inventory with regular reconciliation notes.
rationale.traction: Low daily turnover with volume concentrated in a handful of listings.
rationale.transparency: Verified factory and public docs, but pool-level reporting stays sparse.
rationale.compliance: Generic terms only, with licensing and prospectus status undisclosed.
rationale.durability: One year live with steady operation and no recorded security incident.

facts: cumulative volume in USD across tracked pools

venues.name: PAIR
venues.thesis: PAIR tokenizes collectibles into redeemable vault shares with light trading volume.

rationale.asset: Vaulted collectibles carry appraisals and redemption mechanics for share holders.
rationale.traction: Thin secondary flow with most activity clustered around new vault openings.
rationale.transparency: Verified contracts and published vault lists, though appraisals are infrequent.
rationale.compliance: Sale terms published with collector-grade disclosure, no financial license cited.
rationale.durability: Young venue with short operating history and narrow liquidity buffers.

facts: vault TVL in USD at the cut date

venues.name: Bankr
venues.thesis: Bankr publishes a live launcher but no verifiable volume or backing evidence.

rationale.asset: Launches reference synthetic exposure without custody or redemption proof.
rationale.traction: No verifiable volume series, only self-reported launch counts.
rationale.transparency: Factory verified with docs online, but pool accounting stays closed.
rationale.compliance: Standard launcher terms with no regulatory statement on listed assets.
rationale.durability: Operating for over a year with modest but continuous launch cadence.

facts: verifiable volume at the cut date

venues.name: Cardpad
venues.thesis: Cardpad documents its collectible vaults well while trading almost nothing.

rationale.asset: Vault contents listed with photos and appraisals, but coverage is uneven.
rationale.traction: No verifiable secondary volume across the observation window.
rationale.transparency: Exemplary docs, verified contracts, and a named team behind the vaults.
rationale.compliance: Collector sale terms published, without any financial license reference.
rationale.durability: Recent launch with limited history and shallow reserves.

facts: verifiable volume at the cut date

venues.name: Factory New
venues.thesis: Factory New ships launch tooling with no backing claim and no measurable market.

rationale.asset: No backing claim beyond launch mechanics, so asset quality scores on tooling alone.
rationale.traction: No verifiable volume and only a handful of test runs on record.
rationale.transparency: Factory verified and code readable, with docs limited to launch guides.
rationale.compliance: No terms covering asset listings and no entity willing to stand behind them.
rationale.durability: Weeks old with single-operator dependency and no track record.

facts: verifiable volume at the cut date

venues.name: CSL
venues.thesis: CSL is a thin prelaunch listing with a deployed factory but no market yet.

rationale.asset: No backing inventory shown, only a placeholder token with no claim attached.
rationale.traction: No launches completed and no volume series to evaluate.
rationale.transparency: Factory verified with a holding page, full docs still pending.
rationale.compliance: No terms, no entity, and no disclosure of any kind.
rationale.durability: Prelaunch with no operating history and unclear funding.
